title: GTA 6 Original Soundtrack Revealed with 34 Songs and Real-World Artists
description: Grand Theft Auto 6's original soundtrack has been partially revealed, featuring 34 original tracks and real-world artists. Six tracks are available to stream today.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Original Soundtrack Partially Revealed: 34 Tracks and Real-World Artists Confirmed

Music has always been the heartbeat of the Grand Theft Auto series, setting the tone for chaotic street chases, sun-drenched coastal drives, and cinematic storytelling. Today, according to a report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, the music landscape for the upcoming open-world crime game *Grand Theft Auto 6* has come into sharper focus with the partial reveal of its original soundtrack.

### What We Know About the Soundtrack

While Rockstar Games continues to keep many details of *GTA 6* under wraps, the recent soundtrack revelation gives fans a concrete look at the audio experience awaiting them:

- **Album Size**: The full original album will feature a total of **34 original tracks** crafted specifically for the game.
- **Artist Collaborations**: The project includes music produced in collaboration with multiple real-world artists, bridging the gap between authentic industry talent and the game's immersive universe.
- **Early Access**: Fans do not have to wait for launch to experience the vibe—**six tracks are available to stream today**.

### Context and Expectations

Looking back at previous entries in the franchise, Rockstar's dedication to curation and original composition has consistently set industry benchmarks. The inclusion of 34 original tracks suggests a massive audio undertaking designed to complement the expansive open-world design of *GTA 6*. While analysts and fans speculate on how these tracks will integrate into in-game radio stations, dynamic missions, and ambient exploration, the immediate availability of the first six songs offers a welcome taste of what is to come.

### Editor's Take

Releasing six tracks early is a brilliant move by Rockstar Games, keeping the community engaged without spoiling the entire experience. With 34 original songs and a lineup of real-world artists, *GTA 6* is shaping up to deliver an auditory masterpiece that matches its colossal scale. We cannot wait to hear the rest of the album when the game finally arrives.
